Hypothesis held; numbering runs 1-39 unbroken. Sibling of 31/6/1: every question matched by CONTENT against data/2025-31-6-1.questions.json and confirmed on this paper's page before its stem, context, options, answer, chapter, subtopic and difficulty were reused byte-for-byte; _figure notes and page indices were written fresh from this paper's pages. 38(I) differs from 31/6/1 (it drops '(Refer above figure)') and 32 differs (power -0.5 D, not +2.0 D), so both were transcribed fresh. Instruction (viii) prints NO count of internal choices, so the roster was built by walking the marking scheme (ms pages 0-9, every footer X_086_31/6/3): a bare OR after Q23, 24, 28, 34, 35, 36 and inside Q37(III), Q38(III), Q39(III) = 9 alternatives, each confirmed against a printed OR on the paper. All 20 Section-A answers are CBSE's own, read off the scheme image; each re-derived and agrees. No void notes anywhere in the scheme. Decimal points on this paper are ORDINARY full stops (Q16 0.5 kJ, Q32 -0.5 D); the scheme uses raised dots (0·22 A, 0·05%). Case studies print (I), (II), (III)(a) OR (III)(b): refs follow 31/6/1 (Q37i, Q37ii, Q37iiia, Q37iiib). Q35's first branch carries no printed (a) label (parts (a)(b)(c), then OR, then parts (a)(b)); filed as Q35a / Q35b as in 31/6/1.
